Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 we hereby inform you that the Board of Directors of the Company at their meeting held on November 14, 2026 have inter
alia transacted the following business:
1.    Considered and approved the Unaudited Financial Results and Limited Review report of the Company for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026; We are enclosing herewith the Unaudited Financial Results and Limited Review Report for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. 
2.    Considered and approved the signing of New Joint Development Agreement (JDA) and power of attorney for the development of property situated at vilankurichi.
